text:
Olivia (Finance): Hi team, received a rebate claim from a GCP marketplace partner for invoice GCP-MP-2028-09-02. They say rebate lines didn't attach to customer accounts so partner payout is off. Need quick triage before settlement. :thinking:

Keon (Billing): Can you paste the partner claim details or sample line?

Olivia (Finance): Partner claim snippet: `invoice GCP-MP-2028-09-02 \nline: marketplace:asia-east1:partner-Orion:rebate  Units: 1  AmountUSD: -2,750.00  attributes: {rebate_code: Q3_PARTNER, customer_meter: cm-7788}` but our ledger shows the rebate hit vendor payable instead of reducing customer charges.

Sasha (Partner Ops): Orion says they included customer_meter on their side. They expect rebate to net against the customer's metered charge, not as a vendor-level rebate.

Rohan (Platform): Quick look in ingestion: the rebate events were classified as charge_type=vendor_credit because the payload had field `rebate_to` set to `partner` instead of `customer`. Partner claims their integration toggles this flag based on marketplace UI; could be a config mismatch. Log: `WARN transform.rebates - rebate_to=partner; treating as vendor_credit`

billing-bot: Automated scan: Unattached rebate detected = $2,750.00 on GCP-MP-2028-09-02. Suggested actions: confirm partner intent, reprocess with rebate_to=customer to net against metered lines, or manual ledger adjustment. Link: https://billing.internal/recon/GCP-MP-2028-09-02

Keon (Billing): If partner confirms they intended customer rebate, we can re-run transform on that invoice day and patch the rebate_to field, which should apply as contra-charge to the matching customer meter. Rohan, ETA to reprocess one invoice day?

Rohan (Platform): I can reprocess the 09-02 batch in ~45 minutes. I'll add a temporary override to treat rebate_to=partner OR rebate_to=customer as customer-directed if customer_meter present. Safer than a partner-side config flip.

Sasha (Partner Ops): I'll ping Orion to confirm they intended rebate to apply to specific customers. Also ask them to double-check their marketplace config.

Olivia (Finance): Approve reprocess. If reprocess doesn't resolve, approve a manual ledger correction: DR Vendor Payable 2,750.00 / CR Customer Receivable 2,750.00 to move rebate to customer level. Tag memo "mp-rebate-fix".

billing-bot: Reprocess job started (rp-gcp-rebate-221). Monitor: https://billing.internal/jobs/rp-gcp-rebate-221

billing-bot: Reprocess complete. Outcome: rebate reclassified to customer rebate and netted against customer meter cm-7788. Unattached remainder = $0.00. Reconciliation link: https://billing.internal/recon/GCP-MP-2028-09-02/rp-gcp-rebate-221

Keon (Billing): Verified ledger now shows rebate reducing customer charges. No manual journal needed. Marking invoice reconciled for settlement.

Sasha (Partner Ops): Orion confirmed they intended customer-level rebate and will adjust their marketplace setting to use `rebate_to=customer` going forward. I've attached their confirmation to the partner case.

Olivia (Finance): Please add a short runbook note: when rebate has a customer_meter field, prefer treating it as customer-directed rebate even if rebate_to flag is partner. Rohan, can you add that to the ETL docs?

Rohan (Platform): Will add ETL note and unit test to prevent regressions.

Olivia (Finance): Great, thanks everyone. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
